title: Heraldry Builder
description: Design rule-checked heraldic arms from a fixed menu of tinctures, ordinaries and charges, read the auto-generated blazon, and register them in a searchable community armorial.

dataSources.name: Community armorial (user-generated)
dataSources.description: There is no external dataset. The registry is created at runtime by the widget's own users and stored in the Worker's Cloudflare D1 database (display name, optional public contact, and the structured design with its generated blazon). The committed src/data/sample-registry.json holds 16 fictional, hand-authored entries used as the offline/development fallback; no external armorial (SCA O&A, Heraldry of the World, Wikimedia Commons) is imported. Charge artwork is original to this widget.
